My Story

A Persian girl,
on a London runway

Felina built her world from London — one look, one reel, one honest moment at a time. Then came the moment every girl who loves fashion dreams about: walking the runway at London Fashion Week SS27, in her city, as herself.

This is that walk — Felina front and centre, exactly where she belongs.

Featured — The Moment

“Mama, I made it 🥹”

— Felina, on walking the London Fashion Week SS27 runway

Every creator keeps one post saved — the one that proves it happened. For Felina it is this: a Persian girl from London, walking a London Fashion Week runway at SS27, and telling her mum in exactly the words she always promised she would.
